basis.quote: My lips and tongue are swelling and I am having trouble breathing now.
basis.interpretation: Acute oropharyngeal edema with dyspnea indicates airway compromise risk requiring immediate emergency evaluation and potential airway management.

basis.quote: I got into poison ivy while clearing brush on Saturday. Itchy blistery rash on both forearms, spreading a bit within that area.
basis.interpretation: Acute allergic contact dermatitis initially localized to exposed skin, now progressing to systemic anaphylactic features (oropharyngeal swelling and respiratory symptoms).

output.reason: Acute airway edema and dyspnea in context of allergic progression from poison ivy contact constitute anaphylaxis requiring immediate emergency assessment and airway management.
